newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lufthansa ups ex-France Indian cargo rate.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa ups ex-France Indian cargo rate.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo AG said it had increased its ex-France cargo rates to Indian destinations, notably Bombay, Delhi and Madras, by between six and seven percent, effective January one.
Late last year, Lufthansa said it was introducing ex-Germany cargo rates increases to India of between 15 and 70 percent.
"Despite strong demand and tight capacity, the eastbound market to India, rates have been very low for some time," a Paris/CDG-based Lufthansa cargo official told Reuters .
The German carrier would have had to suspend its services to India out of economic necessity if rates had remained unchanged.
"A probable reason why ex-Europe rates to India had fallen so low is that traditionally, westbound traffic on the route was stronger than the eastbound trade, in contrast to the current situation."

The official said Lufthansa is planning to increase some other ex-France cargo rates by between five and ten percent, effective March 1, but said details are not yet finalised. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
